description: Machine-readable record of every reference dataset this software bundles, for the in-application licences view and for tools/check_data_licences.py. The narrative version is shared/DATA_LICENCES.md.

datasets.name: WHONET reference catalogue
datasets.detail: Organisms, antimicrobials, expert rules, expected resistance, MIC panels, code values and field definitions.
datasets.source: WHONET / WHO Collaborating Centre for Surveillance of Antimicrobial Resistance
datasets.licence: Distributed for antimicrobial resistance surveillance use.

datasets.name: SNOMED CT concept codes
datasets.detail: Concept codes carried on organism rows. Supplementary: WHONET codes are the primary organism identifier, so the application functions with or without SNOMED in use.
datasets.licence: Requires a licence. Free to use in a SNOMED International Member country or territory; an affiliate licence is required elsewhere. This software grants no SNOMED CT licence and a deployment must establish its own position.

datasets.name: LOINC codes
datasets.detail: Susceptibility and measurement codes on antimicrobial rows.
datasets.licence: Free to use under the LOINC licence, with attribution.

datasets.name: ATC codes and defined daily doses
datasets.source: WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology
datasets.licence: Free for non-commercial use; redistribution of the complete index is restricted.

datasets.name: WHO AWaRe classification
datasets.licence: Published for public health use.

datasets.name: ISO 3166-1 country list with WHO regions
datasets.detail: Derived from the country code set already present in the WHONET catalogue, not copied from the ISO standard.
datasets.licence: Country codes are not themselves copyrightable.

datasets.name: ISO 3166-2 country subdivisions
datasets.detail: First- and second-level administrative subdivisions for 200 countries, used when a country has no curated geo pack. Fifty territories have none in the standard and start with an empty tree.
datasets.source: ISO 3166-2, via the tables bundled with pycountry (Debian iso-codes)
datasets.licence: Used under the deploying organisation's ISO licence. Subdivision codes and names are reproduced from the standard, so a deployment redistributing this software needs its own ISO licence.

datasets.name: CLDR locale defaults
datasets.detail: Locale, text direction, numbering system, time zones, first day of week and date field order.
datasets.source: Unicode CLDR, via the ICU data built into Node
datasets.licence: Unicode Licence — permissive, with attribution.

datasets.name: India administrative units (LGD codes)
datasets.source: Local Government Directory, Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India
datasets.licence: Administrative codes published for public administrative use.

datasets.name: Google Address Data Service address formats
datasets.detail: Per-country postal address form metadata: which fields exist, which are required, their local names, write order, uppercasing and postal-code patterns. Subdivision names within the dataset are not used; administrative units come from the ISO 3166-2 pack.
datasets.source: Google libaddressinput project, vendored by the google-i18n-address package
datasets.licence: Apache License 2.0 (libaddressinput dataset). The google-i18n-address packaging is BSD-3-Clause and is a build-time dependency only. Redistribution is permitted with attribution and the licence text.

datasets.name: GeoNames postal codes and cities500 gazetteer
datasets.detail: The bundled geographic directory: 1,080,715 postal codes across 121 countries and 235,285 settlements of 500 people or more across 246, used to resolve a facility's postal code or town to coordinates. Population-weighted subdivision centroids are derived from the same data as a last-resort fallback. Never applied to a patient's residence.
datasets.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Redistribution is permitted with attribution. The United Kingdom extract carries Royal Mail copyright and database right and is supplied without warranty of accuracy or completeness.

datasets.name: Genomic AMR marker catalogue
datasets.detail: Marker names are nomenclature; the selection is curated from published literature.
datasets.licence: Nomenclature and published findings.

datasets.name: CLSI breakpoint tables
datasets.detail: Linked and importable only. The application never redistributes these tables.
datasets.licence: Paid standard; M100 requires a CLSI licence.

datasets.name: EUCAST breakpoint tables
datasets.detail: The published table ships with the installer and is refreshed in place by the Breakpoint Centre's update button. Extracted from EUCAST's own workbook by tools/fetch_eucast_breakpoints.py; no value is derived or interpolated.
datasets.licence: Published free of charge; redistribution permitted with attribution.

datasets.name: ICD-10 diagnosis starter value set
datasets.detail: A small set of WHO ICD-10 category codes for the infection syndromes AMR surveillance reports on, seeded into the editable coded-value catalogue so diagnosis is captured as a code rather than free text. A deployment is expected to extend or replace it with its national value set.
datasets.licence: ICD is published by WHO and is freely available for use. WHO retains copyright; reproduce with attribution and do not present a modified list as the classification itself.

datasets.name: ICD-11 MMS starter value set (bundled subset)
datasets.detail: 40 ICD-11 Mortality and Morbidity Statistics codes covering the infection syndromes AMR surveillance reports on, plus WHO's MG50-MG54 antimicrobial-resistance findings. Retrieved from WHO's own ICD API (release 2026-01) by tools/fetch_icd11.py, not transcribed: every code was confirmed to exist and confirmed to carry the concept it was requested for, and WHO's title is the display. A subset of the linearisation, not the linearisation. No ICD-10 to ICD-11 mapping is bundled - WHO's API publishes none, and a mapping this repository invented would attach a guess to a patient diagnosis.
datasets.source: World Health Organization, via the WHO ICD API
datasets.licence: ICD-11 is published by WHO under CC BY-ND 3.0 IGO. Attribution is required and derivative works are not permitted, so this subset is reproduced unmodified - WHO's codes and WHO's titles, selected but never edited. A deployment that needs a modified list must take that up with WHO rather than change this asset.

datasets.name: LOINC susceptibility concepts (bundled subset)
datasets.detail: 917 LOINC concepts from the ABXBACT class, plus the three observation codes AMRIT binds to (organism identification, susceptibility panel, microbiology report). A subset of the release, not the release: only the codes this software actually emits are bundled, retrieved from the HL7 public terminology server and pinned by content hash. The WHONET catalogue's own loinc_mlc/loinc_sbt columns are not used - they code minimum lethal concentration and serum bactericidal titer, neither of which AMRIT measures.
datasets.licence: Free to use under the LOINC licence, with attribution. This copyright notice and the LOINC terms travel with the subset; see https://loinc.org/license/.

datasets.name: UCUM units
datasets.detail: The three units AMRIT measures in: mg/L for an MIC, mm for a zone diameter, ug/mL where a legacy import carries it. Bundled as codes on quantities, not as the UCUM specification.
datasets.licence: Free and permissive: use, copy and distribute permitted with the copyright notice retained. No registration required.

datasets.name: ICD-10 categories from the WHO ICD API
datasets.detail: 1,135 categories and subcategories from chapters I (infectious and parasitic diseases) and XXII (codes for special purposes, including U82-U85 antimicrobial resistance), plus the pneumonia and urinary-tract blocks AMR surveillance codes into. Titles are WHO's own, taken verbatim from the API. Not the whole classification: the chapters an AMR deployment uses.
datasets.licence: ICD is published by WHO and freely available for use. WHO retains copyright; reproduce with attribution and do not present a modified or extended list as the classification itself.

datasets.name: SNOMED CT descriptions for bundled catalogue concepts
datasets.detail: Fully specified names for the 2,089 SNOMED concepts the WHONET organism and specimen catalogue references, retrieved from a terminology server and gated by code_systems.snomed.enabled. 13 catalogue references do not resolve at all and are recorded as rejected rather than emitted - among them Candida auris, which matters because it is a WHO critical-priority pathogen.
datasets.source: SNOMED International, via a terminology server
datasets.licence: Requires a licence. Free to use in a SNOMED International Member country or territory (India is one); an affiliate licence is required elsewhere. This software grants no SNOMED CT licence, and a deployment that has not accepted one switches SNOMED off in its country profile, which omits these codes from output with a stated reason rather than substituting anything.
